description: Prepare a loan: pledge a token, receive USDG (or the lend asset named by lendAsset), repay a fixed amount of it within the term. Use the prepare object of gage_borrow_quote, without its action. Returns the next unsigned transaction and a review link; never signs.

cap.description: To repay, raw units of the loan's asset, above principal

lendAsset.description: The asset the loan is paid in and repaid in: USDG when omitted, or a lend asset gage_capabilities lists (its token address)

principal.description: To borrow, raw units of the loan's asset (USDG: 6 decimals)

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of the terms gage_capabilities lists

name: gage_prepare_borrow
title: Prepare: Borrow
